name: Hebi Jonin

entries.name: Cunning Action
entries.text: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action.

entries.name: Evasive
entries.text: When subjected to a Dexterity saving throw, if you would pass, you instead take no damage and suffer no effects.

entries.name: Earth Glide
entries.text: Gain a burrow speed equal to your movement speed.

entries.name: Hebi Regeneration
entries.text: At the beginning of each of your turns, roll 1d8. On a roll of 5-8, regain a number of hit points equal to twice your level.

entries.name: Serpent Senses
entries.text: You have 30 feet of darkvision and 15 feet of tremorsense.

entries.name: Sneak Attack
entries.text: Once per turn, you deal an extra 1d8 damage per two levels when you hit a target with an attack and have advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of your ally, as long as you don't have disadvantage.

This adversary has the blood of the King of Hunters. At the beginning of each of this adversary's turns, it can spend 1 Tenacity die to regain hit points equal to 1/10th of its hit points. Additionally, it can spend 1 Tenacity die to coat its weapon in poison, increasing its damage die by +1 and making its damage type poison, in addition to whatever its previous damage type was.

entries.name: Elite Lurker
entries.text: You gain a +1 bonus to critical threat range on all attacks.

entries.name: Lurker Passive 1
entries.text: You cannot be seen by Chakra Sight.

entries.name: Lurker Passive 2
entries.text: You cannot be sensed by tremorsense or thermal vision. (You can still be seen normally, but these special senses cannot detect you.)

entries.name: Lurker Action
entries.text: By spending 4 Tenacity dice and its action, this adversary can teleport to any space within 90 feet that it can see or is aware of and that would grant it full/total cover or heavily obscure it.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Hebi Jonin may make three attacks with its currently equipped weapon.

entries.name: Katana
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage, and once per turn the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save against Serpent Venom (SHB p. 46).

entries.name: Senbon
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) piercing damage, and once per turn the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save against Serpent Venom (SHB p. 46).

The Hebi Jonin takes one Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn, once each round, to either move, attack, cast a jutsu, or spend its Elite Action to gain an additional reaction. It regains spent Elite Actions at the beginning of each of its turns.

notes: Both weapon attacks print +6 to hit, below the Bukijutsu line's +10; kept as printed.
